implementation.name: fpgagen (MiST)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 47 HDL source files (2 systemverilog, 3 verilog, 42 vhdl). There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: hand-mapped, not MRA-setname-derived -- a MiST console core ships no MRA file. The core reimplements the Sega Mega Drive / Genesis, giving machine_id genesis, each checked against extract/machine.json. license_id omitted: the repository has no LICENSE, COPYING or COPYRIGHT file at its root and no licence grant was found in the 12 HDL headers read. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 47 source files (2 systemverilog, 3 verilog, 42 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify. Platform: the compiled core is distributed through mist-devel/mist-binaries, whose cores/ directory is the MiST core set.
